prompts.sentence: Each paper begins with a 200-word ___ of its findings.
prompts.explain: En contexto académico el resumen inicial se llama the abstract.

prompts.sentence: Can you give me a quick ___ of what happened at the meeting?
prompts.explain: Para un resumen informal se dice summary, no abstract.

prompts.sentence: You should speak to a ___ before signing the contract.
prompts.explain: El abogado que ejerce es a lawyer o attorney. Advocate es quien defiende una causa.

prompts.sentence: She is a lifelong ___ for children's rights.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es advocate: defiende una causa públicamente.

prompts.sentence: The film is not ___ for young children.
prompts.explain: Apto para algo es suitable. Apt significa acertado o propenso a.

prompts.sentence: "Chaotic" is an ___ description of the situation.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es apt: una descripción muy acertada.

prompts.sentence: It was ___ of him to believe that story.
prompts.explain: Cándido (ingenuo) es naive. Candid es franco y directo.

prompts.sentence: In a ___ interview, she admitted the project had failed.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es candid: habló con sinceridad.

prompts.sentence: My boss was very ___ when I explained the delay.
prompts.explain: Comprensivo (que comprende) es understanding. Comprehensive es exhaustivo.

prompts.sentence: The report gives a ___ overview of the market.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es comprehensive: cubre todo el tema.

prompts.sentence: If you value honesty, be ___ and tell the truth now.
prompts.explain: Ser consecuente con los principios es to be consistent. Consequent es "resultante".

prompts.sentence: The drought and the ___ crop failure hit the region hard.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es consequent: lo que resulta de la sequía.

prompts.sentence: It would be ___ to see a doctor about that cough.
prompts.explain: Conveniente como "recomendable" es advisable. Convenient es práctico.

prompts.sentence: Would Tuesday at ten be ___ for you?
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es convenient: te viene bien.

prompts.sentence: The ___ helped me find my size.
prompts.explain: El dependiente de una tienda es a shop assistant o clerk. Dependent es "que depende".

prompts.sentence: The result is ___ on the weather.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es dependent: depende del tiempo.

prompts.sentence: He took a ___ job for the summer months.
prompts.explain: Un trabajo eventual es a temporary job. Eventual es "final".

prompts.sentence: Everyone expected the ___ collapse of the company.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es eventual: lo que acabó ocurriendo.

prompts.sentence: The device could ___ if it overheats.
prompts.explain: Explotar (estallar) es explode. Exploit es aprovecharse de algo.

prompts.sentence: The company was accused of trying to ___ its workers.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es exploit: explotación laboral.

prompts.sentence: He's an ___ character who wears a cape to work.
prompts.explain: Extravagante (excéntrico) es eccentric. Extravagant es gastar en exceso.

prompts.sentence: They spent an ___ amount on the wedding.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es extravagant: gasto desmedido.

prompts.sentence: The constant noise from upstairs is really ___.
prompts.explain: Fastidioso es annoying. Fastidious es meticuloso hasta el detalle.

prompts.sentence: She is ___ about keeping her notes in order.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es fastidious: extremadamente cuidadosa.

prompts.sentence: What a ___ idea — it solves everything!
prompts.explain: Genial (excelente) es brilliant o great. Genial en inglés es afable.

prompts.sentence: Our host was a ___ man who made everyone feel welcome.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es genial: trato cordial y amistoso.

prompts.sentence: It was very ___ of you to help her with the bags.
prompts.explain: Gentil (amable) es kind. Gentle es suave en el trato o el movimiento.

prompts.sentence: Use a ___ soap on the baby's skin.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es gentle: no agresivo.

prompts.sentence: The main ___ of the plan is the cost.
prompts.explain: Un inconveniente (desventaja) es a drawback. Inconvenient es un adjetivo: inoportuno.

prompts.sentence: Is Friday ___ for you? We can move it.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es inconvenient: te viene mal.

prompts.sentence: Ten guests were ___ by the shellfish.
prompts.explain: Intoxicado por comida es food poisoned. Intoxicated significa borracho.

prompts.sentence: He was arrested for driving while ___.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es intoxicated: bajo los efectos del alcohol.

prompts.sentence: Cleaning the archive was a long and boring ___.
prompts.explain: Una labor concreta es a task o job. Labor es mano de obra en general.

prompts.sentence: The cost includes materials and ___.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es labor: el coste de la mano de obra.

entries.note: In labor también significa "de parto": She went into labor.

prompts.sentence: He left his ___ possessions behind and joined the monastery.
prompts.explain: Mundano (terrenal) es worldly. Mundane es aburrido y rutinario.

prompts.sentence: Most of the job is ___ paperwork.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es mundane: tareas monótonas.

prompts.sentence: She gives ___ lessons at her home.
prompts.explain: Clases particulares son private lessons. Particular es "concreto".

prompts.sentence: Is there a ___ reason you chose this city?
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es particular: una razón concreta.

prompts.sentence: The ___ was damaged by heavy trucks.
prompts.explain: El pavimento de la calzada es the road surface. En inglés británico pavement es la acera.

prompts.sentence: Please walk on the ___, not in the street.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es pavement (británico): la acera. En EE. UU. se dice sidewalk.

entries.note: Varía por dialecto: en inglés americano pavement sí puede ser el asfalto.

prompts.sentence: Look at the ___ to find the exit.
prompts.explain: Un plano es a map o a plan. Plain es sencillo o liso.

prompts.sentence: I ordered a ___ omelette, with nothing in it.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es plain: sin añadidos.

prompts.sentence: The metal ___ inside the mattress broke.
prompts.explain: Un resorte es a spring. Resort es un complejo turístico.

prompts.sentence: They spent a week at a beach ___ in Mexico.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es resort: un hotel vacacional.

prompts.sentence: Eating vegetables keeps you ___.
prompts.explain: Sano de cuerpo es healthy. Sane es sano mentalmente, cuerdo.

prompts.sentence: The court found him ___ and fit to stand trial.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es sane: en pleno uso de sus facultades.

prompts.sentence: The festival offers free ___ every evening.
prompts.explain: Espectáculos son shows o performances. Spectacles son gafas.

prompts.sentence: He cleaned his ___ before reading the letter.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es spectacles: las gafas, en registro formal.

prompts.sentence: I haven't seen him much ___.
prompts.explain: Últimamente es lately o recently. Ultimately es "al final".

prompts.sentence: ___, the decision is yours.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es ultimately: en última instancia.
